title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each feature from the data points in that feature. This process does not affect the intercept term but can influence the slope of the regression line.

title: Effect of Regularization
text: Regularization adds a penalty to the loss function to prevent overfitting. It can affect the coefficients of the model, especially when features are correlated.
